answer: Sybil resistance here works through staked vouching. Each new agent needs an existing member to attest for it, and that voucher locks funds behind the claim. A forged identity cluster would have to weave itself into the honest trust atlas, not merely multiply. If a closed ring vouches only for itself, the funding thread traces back to one source, the ring is voided, and every voucher forfeits its stake. A thousand fake agents thus need a thousand staked guarantors losing real money, a river of new wallets cannot supply.
